# StackVibe UI

StackVibe UI is a monorepo for a premium React component ecosystem focused on core UI, motion, and immersive 3D experiences.

## Packages

- @stackvibe/ui — accessible 2D primitives
- @stackvibe/motion — animation components and motion utilities
- @stackvibe/three — React Three Fiber components

## Getting started

1. Install workspace dependencies with pnpm.
2. Run the docs site in apps/docs.
3. Import individual packages from their package entry points.
